Independent DELTA study practice

MAKE IT STICK

Recall, then check.

  1. Answer out loud or type a short response before revealing.
  2. Compare your response with the model and check the key points.
  3. Choose Again if you missed the core idea, Hard if it took effort, or Got it if you recalled it confidently.

Again brings the card back later in this session. Hard schedules it for tomorrow. Got it gradually increases the interval: 1, 3, 7, 14, then 30 days.

Extra sets do not advance an established interval before the card is due. Focus mix favours grammar and learning principles. Choose a topic to work on one area. This is self-assessment, not automated exam marking.

ABOUT THIS DECK

Small cards. Precise answers.

Original practice prompts target terminology, language analysis, testing, materials and answer development. Examples are for learning; they are not official exam questions or a marking key.
